Components

52 components, each with a live example, its code in HTML, React and Vue, and its API generated from its component.toml. All of them on one page.

Buttons

ButtonA button, or a link styled as one with href.<ray-button> Button groupButtons joined into one control: inner corners squared, borders overlapped.<ray-button-group> Icon buttonA square button for an icon (Mantine's ActionIcon).<ray-icon-button> ToggleA two-state button (aria-pressed): bold in a toolbar, mute, favorite.<ray-toggle> Toggle groupray-toggle elements with one shared value: type="single" (at most one on: alignment, view mode) or "multiple" (bold / italic / underline).<ray-toggle-group>

Inputs

CheckboxA checkbox with label, description and error.<ray-checkbox> Color pickerPick a color: an inline picker (saturation area, hue, opacity, swatches) and a text field with the picker in a dropdown and an eyedropper.<ray-color-picker> <ray-color-input> Date pickerA date field with a calendar dropdown, and the calendar on its own.<ray-date-picker> <ray-calendar> File uploadA drop zone to pick files: drag, click, keyboard or paste.<ray-file-upload> InputA text field with label, description and error (Mantine's TextInput).<ray-input> Password inputA password field with a button that shows or hides what was typed (Mantine's PasswordInput).<ray-password-input> Radio groupOne choice among options: ray-radio elements inside a ray-radio-group, which is the form control.<ray-radio-group> <ray-radio> SearchA search box: icon, clear button, an optional shortcut that focuses it, and a debounced ray-search event.<ray-search> Segmented controlOne choice among a few, as a segmented row with a sliding indicator.<ray-segmented-control> SelectA select with its own dropdown (keyboard, typeahead, groups); options from child <option> elements or the data property.<ray-select> SliderA native range input (keyboard, touch and screen readers as usual) with label, value display and marks.<ray-slider> SwitchAn on/off toggle with the same API as Checkbox, announced as a switch.<ray-switch> TextareaA multi-line text field that can grow with its content.<ray-textarea>

Navigation

Nav linkA sidebar/navigation item: icon, label, description, badge, active state, and nested nav links that collapse under it.<ray-nav-link> PaginationPage navigation: previous/next, optional first/last, page numbers with ellipses; the number of items stays constant so it does not jump.<ray-pagination> SidebarThe side navigation of an app shell: header, content and footer; on wide screens it collapses to an icon rail, below a breakpoint it becomes an off-canvas drawer.<ray-sidebar> <ray-sidebar-group> TabsTabs and panels (WAI-ARIA tabs pattern): arrows, Home/End, automatic or manual activation.<ray-tabs> <ray-tab> <ray-tab-panel>

Overlays

Command paletteSearch and run actions from the keyboard (Mantine's Spotlight): fuzzy search, groups, shortcuts, ⌘K / Ctrl+K; combobox + listbox pattern in a modal dialog.<ray-command-palette> Dialog (Modal)ray-ds's modal, on the native <dialog>: top layer, the rest of the page inert, focus trapped and restored, stackable.<ray-dialog> DrawerA panel sliding in from an edge: a RayDialog (focus, Escape, persistent, data-dialog-close, returnValue) with another look; modeless for side panels that keep the page interactive.<ray-drawer> MenuA dropdown menu (menu button pattern: arrows, Home/End, typeahead, Enter, Escape) or, with context, a context menu at the pointer.<ray-menu> <ray-menu-item> <ray-menu-label> <ray-menu-divider> PopoverA floating panel anchored to a trigger, in the top layer; closes on Escape and outside clicks.<ray-popover> TooltipA short hint on hover and focus of its child; the label also becomes the child's accessible description.<ray-tooltip>

Data display

AccordionCollapsible sections (WAI-ARIA accordion pattern); one open at a time, or several with multiple.<ray-accordion> <ray-accordion-item> AttachmentA file in a composer, upload list or chat: thumbnail or type icon, name, size, upload progress, error, remove and download.<ray-attachment> <ray-attachments> AvatarAn image, the initials of a name, or a placeholder icon.<ray-avatar> BadgeA short status label.<ray-badge> BlockquoteA quotation set apart from the text (Mantine's Blockquote): a colored edge, a quote mark on it and the attribution below.<ray-blockquote> CarouselSlides in a scroll-snap viewport: native swipe and scrolling, previous/next controls, indicators, keyboard, loop and autoplay with a pause button.<ray-carousel> CodeA block of source code: header with file name and language, copy button, line numbers, highlighted lines, diff lines, wrapping and a "show more" height.<ray-code> IconAn icon of the registry: the whole set (the components' too) changes with setIcons().<ray-icon> IndicatorA dot or a small label on the edge of any element (Mantine's Indicator): "New" on an avatar, an unread count on a bell, an online dot.<ray-indicator> KbdA keyboard key: a raised keycap, or a flat chip (filled or outline) for hints in menus and buttons.<ray-kbd> StatA metric tile: label, value, change against a previous period, note.<ray-stat> TableA data table from columns and data: sorting (aria-sort), row selection, clickable rows, sticky header, striped, empty state.<ray-table>

Feedback

AlertAn inline message: title, text, an icon of the registry, the color variants and an optional close button.<ray-alert> Empty stateWhat a list, table or pane shows when it is empty: icon, title, text and the action that fills it.<ray-empty-state> NotificationToasts: notify(), updateNotification(), hideNotification(), clearNotifications(); shown in a ray-toaster (a polite live region in the top layer).<ray-notification> <ray-toaster> ProgressA determinate or (without value) indeterminate progress bar, announced as a progressbar.<ray-progress> SkeletonA placeholder while content loads: a shimmering block, a circle or text lines; with loaded it shows its content.<ray-skeleton> SpinnerAn indeterminate loading indicator, announced as a status.<ray-spinner>

Layout

Aspect ratioA box with a fixed width/height ratio; its image, video or iframe fills it.<ray-aspect-ratio> CardA surface for grouped content, with optional media, header and footer.<ray-card> SeparatorA horizontal or vertical rule, optionally labeled (Mantine's Divider).<ray-separator> SplitTwo panes with a draggable, keyboard-accessible divider (window splitter pattern); the size can be remembered.<ray-split> Status barThe bar at the bottom of an app window: items on the left and on the right; items with action are buttons.<ray-statusbar> <ray-statusbar-item>

Theme

Theme toggleIcon button that cycles the document theme: system, light, dark.<ray-theme-toggle>
